trabajo.mensajePlaceholder: Tell us about your experience and interests
equipo.citeText: We walked the same path many of our clients are on today.
equipo.introP1: We started in the field, where decisions have an immediate impact on people, safety, operational continuity, and results. Over time we supervised teams, led operations, ran businesses, and took responsibility for their performance.
equipo.introP2: That path taught us that the best decisions don't come from a methodology. They come from reading the reality of each operation and building solutions together with the people who work in it every day.
equipo.highlight: That is the origin of the way Think4Change works today
equipo.darioP1: Operational transformation and industrial business leadership.
equipo.darioP2: More than 25 years leading operations and industrial businesses across Latin America, Central Asia, Africa, and Mongolia, with responsibility for organizations of up to 1,000 employees and operations exceeding US$280 million.
equipo.darioP3: His experience integrates strategy, operational excellence, and business transformation in industries where execution quality defines competitiveness.
equipo.darioP4: MBA from Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez, Executive Education at MIT Sloan, and PhD candidate in Business Administration at the University of Bradford.
equipo.jcP1: Operations, technical excellence, and capability development.
equipo.jcP2: His career began in the field and evolved into leading maintenance operations and the Cummins Chile Technical Excellence Center, where he drove the development of more than 260 specialists.
equipo.jcP3: His experience combines technical knowledge, operational leadership, and people development, with the conviction that capabilities are built by accompanying teams in real work.
equipo.finalQuote: Our way of working was forged where decisions are put to the test every day.
